name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you complete a sacred rite in Ironforge and receive the Light's power to raise the fallen.
As a dwarf, you undertake this trial in Ironforge and earn the Battleforge family's gratitude on behalf of the kingdom.
As an Alliance champion, you train in the Light to face the Scourge and the Dark Iron clan.

faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred trial for holy champions in Ironforge. By proving your spiritual readiness, you learn to channel the Light and bring fallen companions back to life.
faq.q: What is The Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a revered dwarven teacher of the Light in Ironforge. She gives the final blessing to champions ready to wield the power of resurrection.
After you complete an earlier trial in the field, Tiza Battleforge's husband directs you to her. He is already in Ironforge and sends you to his wife with pride and encouragement.
faq.q: Who sends you to Tiza Battleforge?

faq.answer: The Symbol of Life is a holy item used in a paladin's trials. It answers only to a champion whose devotion makes them worthy to call a fallen ally back from death.
faq.q: What is the Symbol of Life?

faq.answer: When you present yourself to Tiza Battleforge, she blesses you with a sacred scroll that teaches Redemption, the power to restore fallen allies to life.
faq.q: What ability do you learn from completing this quest?

aliases: why fight dark irons and scourge
faq.answer: Ironforge needs champions of the Light against the Scourge and the Dark Iron dwarves. Their healing and holy defense help protect the realm.
faq.q: Why are champions of the Light needed by Ironforge?

sections.body: You have crossed the kingdom's trials, and now you come to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge. She is a revered teacher of the holy arts. Her husband watches with pride as you approach, eager to see the dwarven people acknowledge your readiness before the Holy Light.
sections.title: A Sacred Rite in Ironforge

sections.body: Tiza Battleforge's final blessing tests whether your heart is ready to wield the Symbol of Life. The relic answers only to one prepared to channel the Light's greatest gifts. Prove your worth, and Tiza grants you a sacred scroll that lets you call fallen comrades back from death. Ironforge needs this power against the Scourge and the Dark Iron clan.
sections.title: The Blessing of Resurrection

summary: In Ironforge, holy champions face a final trial before Tiza Battleforge. The Tome of Divinity shows whether they are ready to wield the Symbol of Life and call fallen allies back to life.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
